title: Support declarative std430 tail padding in config codegen
body: Cel settings leave LightingConfig at a 200-byte payload, so the schema still needs two explicit tail-padding floats to reach std430's 16-byte struct alignment. The generator does not synthesize trailing structure padding. Add declarative tail alignment/padding or derive the final size from the shared ABI instead of encoding dummy fields in the schema.

title: Allow capture tests to override existing node parameters
body: Legacy-versus-cel captures needed the existing LightingConfigNode shadingMode to be selected at runtime, but the capture harness had no typed node-parameter injection path. A special test-only environment hook in BuildRenderGraph.cpp plus CTest/script wiring was needed to force Lambert+GGX for baseline captures. Add declarative graph-node parameter overrides to the capture/test harness.
